# DJ Green Satyr

> DJ Green Satyr is a Phoenix, Arizona DJ and electronic music artist with 30 years of electronic music, rooted in leather culture and the Radical Faerie community. Available for clubs, festivals, leather events, Radical Faerie gatherings, fundraisers, private parties and weddings. Creator of Satyr Arcana, a concept album series where each track is a portrait of a real person.

## Book
- [Book a set / EPK](https://djgreensatyr.live/booking): replies within 24 hours. Email: thegreensatyr@gmail.com
- [Live sets on Mixcloud](https://www.mixcloud.com/GreenSatyr/)

## Music
- [Bandcamp](https://djgreensatyr.bandcamp.com/): Satyr Arcana I (15 tracks), Satyr Arcana Part 2 (17 tracks, October 31, 2026), singles including Dance Floor Whore
- [SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/thegreensatyr)

## Events
- [Events](https://djgreensatyr.live/events): DP, a monthly party on the last Saturday of each month with DJ Jack Daddy Dave.

## The Theatre
- [The Theatre](https://djgreensatyr.live/theatre): stage works by Britannic Zane. Weekly live DJ sets streamed on Mixcloud Live with guest DJs.

## Tools
- [Crate Detective](https://djgreensatyr.live/cratedetective): free beta tool that cleans Rekordbox libraries — duplicates, dead tracks, messy crates.
